@hasseDeriv : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R

def MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv.{u_1, u_2} : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
fun {σ} {R} [CommSemiring R] d ↦
  ((Finsupp.lsum R) fun k ↦ monomial (k - d) ∘ₗ (LinearMap.lsmul R R) ↑(hasseCoeff d k)) ∘ₗ
    ↑(AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv R)
